Leah Park: Quick flag  we're running a two-week hiring blitz for Backend SDE (onsite interview blitz 2026-10-12..2026-10-23). Several panelists already have PTO requests in that window. What's the policy for interview blackout weeks and exceptions?

Marta Lopez: Hi Leah  hiring-related blackout is tricky. We treat heavy interview weeks as a staffing-critical window; panelist PTO should be minimized. Policy: manager approval + hiring manager ack required for PTO that would take a panelist out of scheduled interviews. People Ops needs advance notice (7 business days) for exceptions.

Sam Wu: For eng: if you're scheduled as a required panelist (round co-pilot) we usually block auto-approval. If you have a competing PTO request, either reschedule your interview slot or add a backup panelist. We maintain a backup list to avoid delays.

Priya Shah: Can we automate checking interview calendar conflicts at PTO request time? If the PTO overlaps confirmed interview slots, bot should block auto-approve and request "interview_ack" from hiring manager.

people-ops-bot: Auto-check suggestion: on PTO request -> query `interview-schedule` for confirmed slots. If overlap_found: require `manager` + `hiring_manager` approvals; optionally allow `backup_panelist` param. Example prompt will be shown to the requester.

Leah Park: Example real case: candidate ACME-442 has on-site day 2026-10-15; Panelist @sam.wu has PTO request for 10/15 morning. Solution options: swap Sam with backup @priya, move candidate morning slot to afternoon, or manager approves Sam but provides backup. Which is preferred?

Sam Wu: If moving candidate causes cascade, prefer backup panelist. For candidate experience we shouldn't reshuffle unless unavoidable. I'll add @priya to backups for my panels.

Marta Lopez: People Ops will require the PTO form to include `interview_conflict=true/false` and `backup_panelist=@someone` if true. If no backup is provided, the request will be escalated to hiring_manager for decision.

Priya Shah: One UX ask: bot should show the candidate IDs impacted and the number of panels affected. That helps managers weigh impact.

interview-coordinator-bot: Detected overlaps: Sam Wu -> candidate ACME-442 (2026-10-15 09:00-11:00), ACME-447 (2026-10-18 14:00-15:30). Suggested backups: Priya Shah, Diego Ramos.

people-ops-bot: Proposed PTO request flow for interview windows:
```
1) Employee files PTO request as normal.
2) System auto-checks calendar -> if interview overlap found, block auto-approve.
3) Notify manager + hiring_manager with impacted candidate IDs and suggested backups.
4) Manager/hiring_manager approve or require reschedule. Provide backup if approving.
5) Audit record must include backup_panelist and decision rationale.
```

Leah Park: Also need to consider timezones for remote interviews. If panelist timezone difference means PTO only covers non-overlap hours, we should allow partial-day approvals and keep panelist for unaffected hours.

Sam Wu: Good point. Another edge-case: panelist with recurring "panel duty" rota. For people in that rota, we should enforce a calendar lock for blitz windows and require 14-day notice for PTO.

Marta Lopez: Action items: 1) update PTO form to include `interview_conflict` check and `backup_panelist` field, 2) add flow to PTO policy FAQ for "hiring blitz" windows, 3) implement calendar hook for interview-coordinator-bot to flag conflicts on request. I'll draft language.

Priya Shah: Can we add a quick Slack command for hiring managers to nominate backups? Example: `@interview-coordinator-bot nominate-backup --candidate ACME-442 --panelist sam.wu --backup priya.shah` That would attach backup automatically to existing PTO request.

interview-coordinator-bot: Command accepted. Nomination recorded for ACME-442. Backup assigned: Priya Shah. Notification sent to Sam Wu.

Marta Lopez: One more compliance note: we must include interview blackout exceptions in audit logs (hiring manager decision, reason) in case of candidate fairness audits. People Ops will require a one-line reason for all such exceptions.

Leah Park: Thanks everyone. I'll circulate the backup roster and flag required panelists. Will follow up with a CSV of slots to feed the calendar hook.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Marta to publish FAQ + PTO form update by 2026-09-10. Interview-coordinator-bot to schedule a demo of the calendar hook next Tuesday.
